name: Lost Heaven Roleplay
loginDescription: The streets remember. Pick up where you left off.
registerDescription: A new name. A fresh start. A place in Lost Heaven.
passwordHint: 10–128 characters. Make it yours to keep.
rememberMe: Sign me in automatically on this device
spawningDescription: Your character is ready. Waiting for the city to finish loading.
returningDescription: Your place is waiting, right where you left it.
savedNote: Your place in the city is saved when you leave.
randomNote: Your first character is chosen for you. Your story is yours.
previewNote: Sign in inside the game to enter Lost Heaven.

errors.invalidUsername: Use 3–24 letters, numbers or underscores for your username.
errors.invalidCredentials: That username and password do not match.
errors.rememberedExpired: Your saved sign-in has expired. Enter your password again.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is already registered. Choose another or sign in.
errors.alreadyOnline: This account is already in the city. Disconnect the other session first.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: The city registry is unavailable. Please try again.
errors.notReady: The city is still loading. You will enter as soon as it is ready.
errors.timeout: The city did not answer. Please try again.
errors.banned: This account is banned. Contact an administrator.

recorder.title: Camera recorder
recorder.movement: WASD move · Q / E down / up · Shift faster · Alt slower
recorder.look: Arrow keys or right-drag to look · Space + mouse left / right to roll · Backspace removes the last point · This camera can pass through walls.

status.ready: Frame your first shot, then press F2.
status.pointAdded: Camera position and viewing direction recorded.
status.newSpline: Previous spline kept. Ready to record a new shot.
status.needPoints: Record at least two points in each spline first.
status.saved: Paths saved. They will play on the next connection.
status.saveFailed: Could not save the paths. Try again.

admin.denied: Your rank does not allow this command.
admin.playerMissing: Player {player} is not connected. Use their username or #player ID.
admin.spawnRequired: Both players must be alive and in the city.
admin.failed: The command could not be completed.
admin.cooldown: Wait a moment before spawning another car.
admin.weaponUsage: Usage: /weapon <weapon ID> [ammo] [player]. Use /weapons to list IDs.
admin.helpUser: /players lists players. /logout forgets this device and returns to login.
